title: RAGLAN ROAD | DISNEY SPRINGS UPDATE 2016
description:
Join our group of VIP Dreamers and get access to exclusive travel information from JFT at https://bit.ly/JFTVIP We met up with some friends at Disney Springs for dinner at Raglan Road and checked out the updates in Disney Springs while we were there.

Enjoy a genuine Irish meal, complete with its own unique twists and a dash of Celtic creativity.
At Raglan Road, you can indulge in an award-winning menu crafted by one of Ireland’s most beloved culinary wizards. Master Chef Kevin Dundon has brilliantly reimagined traditional Celtic favorites like shepherd's pie, fish & chips and bangers and mash—and created some modern “classics” of his own, delighting American presidents, British royalty and international rock stars.

And now Raglan Road also offers a lovely Irish-inspired brunch every Saturday and Sunday—from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM!

Thirsty? Mosey up to one of 4 imported bars (some of which have been sliding glasses for 130 years) as you imbibe the ambience of Raglan Road’s interior—shipped lock, stock and beer barrel from Ireland. After chewing up the scenery, soak up some suds as you choose from Irish, European and American beers, including local and craft varieties.

For those having trouble deciding which pint to pick out, get a bird’s eye view of an assortment of brews by taking off with a beer flight instead! Guests must be 21 years of age and up to purchase alcoholic beverages. Advance reservations are highly recommended and can be made up to 180 days prior to your visit.

Kick up your feet and join in the foot-stomping fun as the Raglan Road stage comes alive each night!
Showcasing Irish tunes, popular ballads and pub classics from eclectic house bands—along with spectacular jigs and energetic reels performed by our award-winning dancers—the traditional live entertainment is yours to behold 7 nights a week, starting at 6:00 PM.

Be sure to bring the little ones along too! During each performance, kids are invited to come on stage and join the dancers. They can even receive a signed certificate of achievement, just by participating.
